# Recipe Index

> A curated, source-linked ledger of 50 egg-free vegetarian recipes that each
> clear explicit protein-per-serving and protein-per-calorie gates.

## Use this when

- Looking for practical high-protein vegetarian food ideas.
- Comparing source-published calories and protein on the same serving basis.
- Filtering recipes by ingredients, protein source, or practicality in India.
- Finding the credited original publisher before relying on a recipe.

## Product surfaces

- [Recipe ledger](https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/)
- [Markdown product brief](https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/index.md)
- [Full agent brief](https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/llms-full.txt)
- [Recipe data](https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/data/curated-recipes.json)
- [Agent catalog](https://veg-protein-food.significanthobbies.com/api-ai.json)

## Limits

- Publisher nutrition is a comparison aid, not medical advice.
- Missing quantities are not invented or recalculated.
- Substitutions can change the published nutrition.
- The collection is curated, not an exhaustive recipe database.
